info.title: mcp-fs REST API
info.description: The /api/fs data plane: bytes plane (upload/download/zip) plus full parity with the fs.* MCP tools. Auth: Bearer JWT in the Authorization or X-Forwarded-Authorization header.

post.summary: Extract a document to Markdown and store it as a companion .md next to the source (report.pdf -> report.md), reusing it if already up to date. Returns md_path + a preview; read the .md with fs.read for the full content. Handles PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, CSV, images (OCR via a configured multimodal provider) and text; audio/video unsupported.
post.description: MCP tool: fs.extract_text. Extract a document to Markdown and store it as a companion .md next to the source (report.pdf -> report.md), reusing it if already up to date. tools.name: git.remote_clone
tools.description: Clone a remote git repository (GitHub, GitLab, or any HTTPS URL) into a volume. Uses the OAuth token stored by git.auth if available for the detected provider. Copies all files into the volume AND imports the full git history into the git backend. Use depth=1 for a shallow clone (faster on large repos).

mount_id.description: Project/volume id the clone is imported into.

url.description: Remote git repository URL (GitHub, GitLab, or any HTTPS URL).

branch.description: Branch to clone; omit to use the remote default branch.

depth.description: Shallow clone depth; 0 clones the full history.
